text: steenbarger: 'Resolve structure 88.4 vs structure_shift RANGE, or abstain.' Resolved: structure 88.4 is a composite strength score; RANGE is location, a close inside the swing with no pivot broken. In C2 terms that is a retracement inside a strong swing: buying a higher low. Your pct_from_52w_high -24.91 and flat ma_50 40.43 / ma_100 40.46 say the longer trend is a repair, so I cut to 2 and hold there. I go to OPPOSE if RANGE resolves down through the swing low; I add only on an hourly close above Friday's high.
